tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Set an alarm on the phone for a specific time with optional label/reason

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format or relative ('today', 'tomorrow', '+1day'). Example: '2026-06-21' or 'tomorrow'

label.description: Alarm label/reason. Example: 'Grandad picking up Shae', 'Meeting with team'

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with date, time, title, and optional description

title.description: Event title. Example: 'Lunch with Sarah', 'Project deadline'

date.description: Event date in YYYY-MM-DD or relative format. Example: '2026-06-21' or 'tomorrow'

start_time.description: Start time in HH:MM format. Example: '12:00'

end_time.description: End time in HH:MM format. Example: '13:00'

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS text message to a contact or phone number

contact.description: Contact name from phone or phone number. Example: 'Dad', '+1234567890'

message.description: Message text to send. Keep under 160 characters for single SMS

confirm.description: Request confirmation before sending? Default true for safety

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a time-based reminder for a specific time/date

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD or relative format

time.description: Time in HH:MM format when reminder should trigger

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an app on the phone by name

app_name.description: Name of app to open. Example: 'Chrome', 'Gmail', 'Obsidian', 'Settings', 'Camera'

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a system notification to the phone with title and message

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description: Query phone contacts by name or get full contact list

query.description: Contact name to search for. If empty, returns all contacts

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a timer for a specified duration

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from phone storage

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write or append content to a file

file_path.description: Full file path where to write

append.description: Append to file (true) or overwrite (false)? Default false

tools.name: get_time_and_date
tools.description: Get current time and date in various formats
